narrative.overview: Sidekick is built for minds that bloom at their own pace. The system is a garden rooted in deep forest greens, reaching toward the bright spring-green of new growth. Every screen is a well-tended plot: calm, legible, purposeful. Progress is always visible because plants don't hide their growth, and rewards feel earned because a bloom is evidence, not decoration. It rejects clinical distance, the children's-app reflex, and red-alert shaming. Depth is tonal by default; gradient and shadow are reserved for three deliberate hero moments: the green gradient headers, the dark hero cards, and the floating chat button.
keyCharacteristics: Green is the identity: a single forest-green primary (#0F6E56) carries brand, action, and achievement
Tonal layering for the everyday surface; deliberate gradient + shadow only on hero moments
Warm accents (amber, pink, dark) mark territory now that green is the brand
System fonts tuned to heavy weight contrast (800 headings, 500 body); no decorative type
Line icons for UI chrome; emoji reserved for user-chosen habit/mood expression
Companion-toned: no punitive copy, no shame states, no red-alert patterns

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Growth Green (#0F6E56) is the brand and the only action color. It earns meaning by never being faked: a green element is interactive, branded, or achieved, never a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Territory Rule
rules.body: Now that green is the brand, domain is carried by the warm accents and the dark tile, not by green. Amber means reward/streaks; pink means mood; the dark tint marks deep-focus/hero; coral means danger. Don't use a warm accent outside its domain.

rules.name: The Text-Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Any color carrying words must clear WCAG AA against its surface. Text Secondary (#5C6A62) and Text Muted (#647067) are the floors; Decor Ash and Decor Ash Faint are prohibited as text. Muted gray on near-white is not acceptable.

rules.name: The Weight-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight (800 vs 500), not from a fluid type scale. Sizes are fixed px, not clamp().

rules.name: The One-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked eyebrow appears on the Foco label and the Agenda weekday only. Never put a tracked all-caps kicker above every section.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting cards, inputs, tiles, and buttons carry no shadow. Shadow is reserved for the three hero moments: headers, hero cards, FAB.

dos: Do use Sage Canvas (#F4F7F4) as the screen background, green-tinted toward the brand. Never a warmer or more neutral tint.
Do keep Growth Green (#0F6E56) as the one brand-and-action color; make every green element genuinely interactive, branded, or achieved.
Do carry territory with the warm accents: amber for reward/streaks, pink for mood, the dark tile for deep-focus/hero, coral for danger.
Do keep Text Secondary (#5C6A62) and Text Muted (#647067) as the floors for any text; verify 4.5:1 before shipping.
Do keep one dominant action per screen. The Foco card is the model.
Do reserve real shadow and gradient for the three hero moments; keep ordinary cards flat with a 1px border.
Do pair primary and secondary buttons in modal rows: secondary (outline) left, primary (filled) right.
Do use line icons for UI chrome and reserve emoji for user-chosen habit/mood expression.
Do write companion-toned copy for every empty, error, and past-due state.
donts: Don't use warm-tinted backgrounds (cream, sand, paper, linen, ivory, parchment). The canvas is Sage Canvas, green-tinted.
Don't use clinical or cold palettes: no hospital-white sterility, no corporate blue-gray, no cold neutral surfaces.
Don't ship Duolingo-style shrieking colors, bouncy mascots, or children's-app aesthetics.
Don't design to Jira or Monday energy: dense grids, corporate blues, zero personality.
Don't create ultra-minimalist no-color checklist aesthetics. Empty states need copy and care.
Don't shame users for incomplete tasks. Past-due items are opportunities, not failures.
Don't put words in Decor Ash (#A2ABA4) or Decor Ash Faint (#B4BDB5); those are non-text tints only.
Don't add a shadow to a resting list card, input, or tile. Elevation belongs to the three hero moments only.
Don't apply border-left colored stripes as accents. Use full borders, background tints, or leading icon tiles.
Don't use gradient text. Gradients live on card surfaces and progress bars, never on type.
Don't use a tracked all-caps eyebrow above every section. It is reserved for the Foco label and the Agenda weekday.
